result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers cover every rubric item with concrete structural changes: they slim the banner, collapse the filters, move phone filters into a sticky drawer, cut the grid to 3–4 columns with richer cards, and stay off visual styling. B wins narrowly. It names mobile filter stacking as the likely main cause of the drop, gives a ranked list of quick wins, and adds useful structural ideas such as a list/table view and keeping scroll position on back-navigation. A's list of worst-case scenarios to test is a strong point, but its fixes aren't ranked. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers handle every rubric item well and make close to the same structural recommendations. B is somewhat stronger: it explains why the sidebar and grid scroll out of step, sets a fixed content order for the cards, gives a phone layout that drops quick add and trims the spec line, and lists edge cases to test. A is just as concrete on mobile and pagination, but it gives fewer reasons for the structural problems it names.
